verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents AI Snippets: you define an email template once and reuse it, for yourself or across a team. Templates support `{AI placeholders}` that the AI fills in automatically, which works as a form of variables. That covers the core of inserting saved replies instead of retyping. Missing for 10: any evidence that snippets can carry attachments, documentation of conventional (non-AI) variable or merge fields, and independent or hands-on corroboration of snippet use.
